title: Blood Culture Gram Stain of Gram-Positive Cocci in Bacteremia
author: Spicy
caption: Microscopic Gram stain of a positive blood culture demonstrating Gram-positive cocci in clusters characteristic of staphylococcal bacteremia.
alt_text: Micrograph of purple-stained Gram-positive cocci in clusters among erythrocytes on a blood culture smear.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates microbiological identification of bacteremia, a primary etiology of sepsis (CLIFF-044, p.1, p.6).
